description: Records of packets the firewall allowed or denied: data source 1. The kind keeps no server-side cursor; it reads the newest page and records a gap when the oldest record returned is newer than the newest stored.

functions.description: Called at every probe round: asks the firewall whether this implementation can be read and whether its configuration serves clients.
functions.name: probe

functions.description: Called at every filter-log pass: the newest page_size records, newest first.
functions.name: records

fields.description: The `result` record.
fields.name: result

fields.description: Why the probe could not finish, when it could not.
fields.name: error

fields.description: The `result` record.
fields.name: result

fields.description: The `firewall_log_record` records read, absent when the read failed.
fields.name: records

fields.description: Why the read failed, when it did; the result then says what the firewall answered.
fields.name: error

fields.description: Why this implementation's material can never be read, when that is so: a state, recorded with its reason, and not a failure.
fields.name: unsupported

records.description: One filter-log record, decoded and normalised.
records.name: firewall_log_record

fields.description: The record's identity; a record read twice is stored once.
fields.name: digest

fields.description: When the packet was logged.
fields.name: observed_at

fields.description: The network device the record names; the kind resolves it to an interface.
fields.name: device

fields.description: The source address.
fields.name: src_address

fields.description: The destination address.
fields.name: dst_address

fields.description: The source port, 0 to 65535.
fields.name: src_port

fields.description: The destination port, 0 to 65535.
fields.name: dst_port

fields.description: The protocol's name; empty when the record names none.
fields.name: protocol

fields.description: 4 or 6.
fields.name: ip_version

fields.description: The decision.
fields.name: action

fields.description: The direction the packet crossed the interface.
fields.name: direction

fields.description: The reason the record was logged.
fields.name: log_reason

fields.description: The logged packet length, 0 or more.
fields.name: packet_bytes

fields.description: The rule's label, which the kind resolves to a rule.
fields.name: rid

fields.description: The IPv4 identification, which pairs the two records of one connection.
fields.name: ip_id

fields.description: The TCP sequence number, the other pairing field.
fields.name: tcp_seq
